Student Summer Training
One of ITIDA's Human Capital Development Programs (HCDP)
"Student Summer Training," one of ITIDA's Human Capital Development Programs (HCDP), began in 2014. It offers hands-on training on the
up-to-the-minute technology trends for the students. This summer practice considers increasing the students' capacities and well prepares them to the IT
market post-graduation.
Overview
Students' Summer Internship is one of the Human Capacity Development Programs launched by the Information Technology Industry Development Agency
(ITIDA) in 2014. The program provides free practical training on the latest technology trends for the students. It aims to build students' capacities and prepare
them to work in the IT market after graduation.
In this Summer Internship program, ITIDA collaborates with telecom and technology companies through Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. It
also works with the National Telecommunication Institute (NTI) for its wide technical training experience and diverse partnerships with multiple global tech
companies.
ITIDA offers two summer training programs:
1. ITIDA – NTI Joint Summer Training Program
The ITIDA-NTI Summer Training program consists of two main tracks and lasts for 120 hours total:
(cid:127) Technical Skills Track – duration: 90 hours
(cid:127) Soft Skills / Freelance Track – duration: 30 hours
This training program covers all the governorates of Egypt geographically. It depends on two learning systems: remote/online distance learning, or the
traditional method of attending physically at the various training sites.
ITIDA-NTI Summer Training is a good opportunity for students to get technical training that matches the requirements of the labor market as well as
international exams. Examples of training tracks:

Objectives
(cid:127) Bridge the gap between universities and the labor market requirements
(cid:127) Ensure the ICT sector's participation by providing necessary tech skills for students
(cid:127) Build students' technical and soft skills
(cid:127) Spread business culture among students and raise their awareness
Admission Criteria
Students who have completed the first, second, or third academic year.
Regarding:
(cid:127) NTI programs: Engineering & CS, BIS, Mass Communication, Fine Arts, Applied Arts, Specific Education – Art Education Department (based on the
training program)
(cid:127) Systel Program: Faculty of Computer Science and Engineering
Registration
(cid:127) Systel Program: Closed
(cid:127) NTI Programs: Closed
Agenda
Summer vacation period each year: June, July, August, and September.
Benefits
(cid:127) Offer university students certificates based on attendance stating that they have completed summer training
(cid:127) Help students obtain the credit hours required by their faculties
(cid:127) ITIDA pays the cost of international exams after the student passes them and submits evidence of passing
